records.title: Squeezer: Efficient Multi-DNN Inference for Edge Video Analytics via Cross-Model Scheduling
records.reason: Squeezer is a serving framework that holistically schedules multiple DNN models for edge video analytics on a single GPU, decoupling cross-model scheduling into balanced operator grouping and model-level scheduling; it is genuine inference serving/scheduling, but for vision DNN pipelines rather than LLMs.

records.title: Temporal Order Matters for Agentic Memory: Segment Trees for Long-Horizon Agents
records.reason: SegTreeMem stores conversation history in a temporally ordered segment tree over utterances and propagates retrieval relevance through the hierarchy for long-horizon conversational agents; an external agent-memory retrieval design, not model inference memory or serving.

records.title: High-Accuracy, High-Performance In-Memory Computing With High-Resistance Spin-Orbit Torque (SOT) Magnetic Memory
records.reason: Demonstrates 1-bit quantized networks on spin-orbit-torque MRAM in-memory-computing arrays, addressing device variation, IR drop and program-verify overhead at the circuit/device level; it is memory-device research for generic AI accelerators, not an LLM inference system contribution.

records.title: Towards Compressive and Scalable Recurrent Memory
records.reason: Elastic Memory uses HiPPO-based online compression to encode history into a fixed-size recurrent state with polynomial-sampling retrieval, beating Memorizing Transformer with 16x less memory on 32k+ context tasks and running faster than Melodi at 4x scale; a long-context memory architecture relevant to inference cost, but evaluated as a model architecture rather than a serving system.

records.title: MEME: Multi-entity & Evolving Memory Evaluation
records.reason: MEME benchmarks agent memory systems on six multi-entity/evolving tasks (Cascade, Absence, Deletion) over 100 controlled episodes, finding dependency-reasoning collapse across paradigms; an evaluation of agent memory behavior, not an inference technique.

records.title: CD-LoRA: Consistency-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Task Fine-Tuning
records.reason: CD-LoRA removes routers from multi-adapter LoRA and aligns task representations in a shared low-rank space to fix a training-inference routing discrepancy in multi-task fine-tuning; despite the word inference, the contribution is PEFT training stability, not inference systems.

records.title: 17.3 ARIES and REGULUS: A Unified and Scalable hardware–software co-designed NPU SoC Family for On-Device and On-Premises Multimodal Inference
records.reason: ARIES/REGULUS is a silicon-proven NPU SoC family for on-device and on-premises multimodal inference spanning vision to LLMs, with unified cross-chip scaling, bound- and distribution-aware mixed-precision quantization and piecewise-linear activation handling, showing near-linear performance scaling and high power/bandwidth efficiency in measurements.

records.title: Linear Attention for Joint Power Optimization and User-Centric Clustering in Cell-Free Networks
records.reason: Uses a lightweight transformer with customized linear attention to jointly predict AP clustering and power allocation from spatial coordinates in user-centric cell-free massive MIMO networks; a wireless-network optimization application, not LLM inference.

records.title: Diff-ES: Stage-wise Structural Diffusion Pruning via Evolutionary Search
records.reason: Diff-ES searches stage-wise sparsity schedules for diffusion models by evolutionary search and executes them via memory-efficient weight routing without duplicating pruned models, achieving wall-clock speedups on DiT/SDXL; it is inference-oriented structured pruning, but for image diffusion models rather than LLMs.

records.title: CraniMem: Cranial Inspired Gated and Bounded Memory for Agentic Systems
records.reason: CraniMem gives LLM agents a gated bounded episodic buffer plus a long-term knowledge graph with scheduled consolidation, improving robustness over RAG/Mem0 on long-horizon benchmarks under noise; an agent memory-management design, not model inference.

records.title: Sink vs. diagonal patterns as mechanisms for attention switch and oversmoothing prevention
records.reason: Provides a theoretical analysis of attention sink versus diagonal patterns, proving conditions for oversmoothing prevention and an equivalence between sinks and hard attention switch in pretrained transformers; attention theory without an inference mechanism, kernel, or measured system effect.

records.title: Self-Correcting Long-Horizon Search Agents via Tree-Structured Memory
records.reason: ReTree maintains a bounded per-step reasoning context for search agents as an evidence tree with source-linked summaries, revising branches when new evidence contradicts earlier claims; context management for agent accuracy, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: Mitigating Object Hallucination via Concentric Causal Attention
records.reason: Concentric Causal Attention reorders visual-token positions to counter RoPE long-term decay and reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models; the goal is generation factuality on hallucination benchmarks, with no inference efficiency or serving mechanism.

records.title: Hardware Acceleration of Fully Quantized BERT for Efficient Natural Language Processing
records.reason: FQ-BERT fully quantizes BERT weights, activations, softmax, layer normalization and intermediates for an FPGA accelerator on ZCU102/ZCU111, achieving 7.94x weight compression and 3.18 fps/W (28.91x over CPU, 12.72x over GPU); a concrete quantization-plus-hardware contribution to Transformer inference on edge devices.

records.title: A Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network Based on Self-Attention Mechanism and State Space Model for Efficient Urban Scene Segmentation
records.reason: UMFormer combines self-attention and a Mamba state-space model in an encoder-decoder network for remote-sensing urban scene semantic segmentation; a vision application model whose efficiency claims serve segmentation accuracy, not LLM inference.
